description: Running ~75 min (band [30,60] g/h carbs) — moderate gut intensity. Targets ~45g carbs at 1.0× gut multiplier.
knownFailureReason: CONFIRMED on real dev catalog: rule solver exhibits non-determinism at this target (45g carbs, 600mg sodium) — one solve path picks high_carb_drink_mix×0.5 + electrolyte_capsule×2 delivering 480mg sodium (delta=120mg, above 100mg floor), while another path picks carb_drink_mix + sports_drink + electrolyte_capsule×2 delivering 560mg (passes). The real catalog carb_drink_mix (160mg sodium/serving) vs high_carb_drink_mix (200mg sodium/serving) creates divergent electrolyte-fill paths depending on which carb source scores highest. This non-determinism was masked by the synthetic catalog which had a fixed food set. Underlying issue: primary-carb selection score is not always deterministic between these two similarly-scored drink mixes.
